decisionBody:
Root read ACTUAL ac9182c3e3d606ec027c0be2e90e049ff50d54f1 review including R1-R7/L-a..h and independently verified exactDocs42095556156 plusPortal42095515359/alljobs SUCCESS. 02cfd260 remains REVISION REQUIRED, no ACCEPT/FREEZE. Root chooses a NARROW REV3 below; NO partial CP-schema/phase freeze because authority, lifecycle and lock semantics are coupled. Current authorization DOCS/schema/static fixtures only, no production code/migration/registry/ADR/NodeOps; you remain hard implementation Codex owner after actual revision review. Preserve02cf/100f/actual prior verdicts and use accepted immutable source as anchors.
R1 CHOOSE separated key hierarchy, NOT a single online release key. role-config pins a distinct operator-release verification authority (no CA/root-fence/NodeTLS key reuse). A protected operator-release signer, outside ordinary runtime/online-attestor custody and not on per-request path, issues Node-visible signed RELEASE/DELEGATION objects binding exact approved node/cohort/op/config/policy/C/R/epoch, actual serving-generation or an explicitly authorized same-config readmission transition, bounded validity and delegated use-key public hash/scope. Online role-use issuer owns ONLY delegated per-Node/per-release request key; it cannot sign releases/admissions/fences, choose arbitrary config/generation or extend delegation. Node MUST verify operator-root->release/delegated-key->role-use chain, actual local generation/gate identity, purpose/method/path/body/channel/nonce and expiries; runtime->attestor interface authenticates calling service and attestor loads authoritative current tuple rather than signing caller labels. Define custody, key separation, rotation/revocation, local active release/gate invalidation and all grants explicitly; no actual keys or provenance invented. Signed per-request wire is retained only under this hierarchy for actual re-review.
R2 CHOOSE explicit OBSERVE/RECONCILE and SAFETY authorization lane independent of BUSINESS release availability. At minimum /v1/executions/receipts must remain available under exact existing authenticated CP mTLS/control-peer/epoch checks during fence/expiry/generation discovery; it cannot require an unavailable EXECUTION/MODEL business token. Enumerate methods and exact raw paths, read/ack effects, status/proof/receipt reconciliation and bounded cancel/quarantine safety operations; use separately typed least-privilege safety authority where it mutates, never unauthenticated or generic exemption. Bootstrap observation must obtain fresh generation without requiring an old-generation business grant. Receipt acknowledgement cannot create execution/storage success. All ordinary business mutations still need valid role-use. MODEL vs EXECUTION on identical Node paths is enforced by authenticated CP caller+attestor; Node cannot infer semantic purpose from that path alone.
R3 SPLIT whole-cohort mutation fence from released steady state. Whole-five preflight/fence/final activation applies only to fresh activation or explicit cohort mutation. After release, SAME frozen approved config with unchanged epoch/C/R/root/image/exe/policy/floors may have a specified per-Node READMIT_SAME_CONFIG after a restart/observation expiry, using fresh actual Node/host evidence and protected release authority, only when no cohort mutation fence is active. No unrelated worker/all-five refresh prerequisite. Separate durable operator approval lifetime (bounded by cert/trust/explicit approval) from short node-admission lease and <=120s per-request token; approval/lease expiry and refresh writers/phase rows explicit, no implicit all-five short-expiry liveness coupling. If per-Node authority genuinely revoked/expired, deny that Node; do not invent expired/offline recovery. Selected sets MUST be nonempty unique actual Node IDs, subset of eligible cohort; empty/duplicate/foreign/out-of-range inputs reject before iteration/output.
R4 NAME proposed DB principals and actual grant/function-owner matrix. Separate NOLOGIN schema/procedure owner, protected operator planner/approval/release principal, online verifier/attestor principal and ordinary business runtime principal/pools. Runtime/attestor must not possess operator credentials/SET ROLE path, approval INSERT/UPDATE, release-signing key or planner grants. Runtime read/lock-only applies to AUTHORITY records; nonce consumption/business evidence/operation-ledger procedures are distinct narrowly granted writes, never arbitrary authority provisioning. Distinct DB credentials/connection paths, SECURITY DEFINER owners/fixed search_path/RLS and caller auth explicit. Resolve FK contradiction with acyclic stages: verified candidate observations pre-release are NOT eligible admissions; committed release references verified candidate evidence, then ACTIVE admission rows have a real release FK and current pointers update in the same closed transaction. No dangling fake release or 'FK but no existing release'. State exact atomic boundary/lost-response states, not atomic Engine+DB claims; new tables join RLS census.
R5 Add complete P/C/R/pin/grant/approval/epoch/fence rows for revoke C jump, epoch change and each expiry before intent and after k=0..5 CAS. Ordinary request-token expiry may reissue only under unchanged valid release/current tuple and not during fence. Authority invalidation during partial mutation remains QUARANTINED forward evidence: do NOT admit new reviewed ordinary renewal intent from mixed/revoked/expired state by inference. B-FRESH1 explicitly BLOCKS automatic new-intent/re-enrollment/recovery in that state, names a distinct reviewed recovery gate and keeps observation/containment lane usable. Same-intent forward replay only while exact frozen authority/bytes/current tuples and lease windows still valid; no key/C/P/R reset, silent policy regeneration or old restart. Preflight authority validity must cover bounded operation+skew; uncertain/lost response remains UNKNOWN, not success.
R6 CHANGE canonical B lock order to RESPECT mandatory Database.transaction control_epoch guard: control_epoch FIRST, then routing/fence, sorted inv.nodes, sorted public node/contribution rows, shared node_channels, role/current, then business/run/operator-grant/nonce/evidence/ledger in an explicit final suborder. This supersedes prior fence-before-epoch proposal, never bypass/relax epoch guard. Update operator/fence writer paths too. For leases.py run-before-nodes, containment grant-before-nodes, observation all-online Node locks and db.py epoch entry: lock-free discovery if needed -> canonical locks -> reread/revalidate scope/authority under locks. No stale discovery authorization. Enumerate lock mode SHARE/UPDATE at EVERY actual SQL/ORM callsite including transitive/implicit FK/RLS/outer transaction paths, not path-name heuristic with unclassified=[] by construction. Unknown B writer refuses; required observe/business paths must actually remain usable. No Node I/O while DB row locks held; persist bounded permits/fence then external quiescence then canonical reacquire/recheck. Specify bounded lock_timeout/abort/retry/maintenance-writer contention semantics and actual future PG tests, no starvation guarantee from prose.
R7 SELECT managed separate-kernel Linux VM/own Engine as PRODUCTION CP-colocated B context. WSL2 is NOT an isolated VM from Desktop: any WSL shared-kernel adapter stays a separately reviewed alternative, not automatic fallback or a fifth independent S05/S07 domain. Actual host99percent/low memory is RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, no guest activation. Define RAW measured capability schema/probe/identity/observedAt/producer evidence for host+VM CPU, physical/commit memory, disk, native filesystem, virtual network/routes/TLS reachability and reserved ports; truebooleans+hash alone never suffice. Operator-approved resource budgets required; planning default guest2vCPU/4GiB/20GiB plus host2GiB physical and10GiB disk headroom, all actual budget/bindings NULL until measured approved plan, not Node hard quota claims. VM/boot/context identity vs Node kernel proof explicit; no Desktop/DrvFs/9P/remap/interop/automount source fallback, no install/elevation/private host reads in this DOCS task. Unsupported OS/hypervisor/resources BLOCK, don't invent positive capability.
L-a full-string/byte-alphabet validation across Python/Go/JSONSchema, not '$' alone; newline/control/extra suffix negatives and exact length vectors. L-b explicit time units, exact-int parse, expiresAt>issuedAt and <=120s role-use window, bounded by delegated/release/admission/cert validity. Do not silently reinterpret existing plainv2 time fields. L-c strict UTF8/no lone surrogates before Go replacement, field-specific ASCII/path/identifier rules; preserve legitimate Unicode/U2028 vectors with accepted C2 escaping/no NFC. Exact signature input domain+singleNUL+decoded canonical payload bytes, no LF. L-d purpose source stated perR2. L-e CHOOSE generation-bound IN-MEMORY replay set with cryptographically fresh per-start nonce+kernel identity/start generation, expiry GC and hard size cap failclosed; no per-terminal-frame fsync journal. CP business nonce/evidence commit remains durable. Define stream opener vs frames, sequence/expiry/quiescence and no old-generation token after restart. L-f closed allowlist workload HostConfig decoder including all listed capabilities/namespaces/runtime/sysctls/volumes/cgroup fields; unknown fields deny unless explicitly neutral and tested. L-g explicit callsite semantic inventory plus RLS/schema assets, no heuristic complete claim. L-h canonical fixed-width lowercase device-major/minor uint32hex8 +inode uint64hex16/fs type/context; mount IDs namespace-local, no Windows file-ID==Linux inode fiction.
Publish small unique rev3 contract/schema/phase/grant/key/caller-lock/capability/negative fixture delta, preserve original failures, rebind dependent hashes in attacks and state future actual Go/PG/Docker0. No whole freeze from181staticcases. All real bindingsNULL/HOLD. Actual review must resolve these before Root registers any B wire/authority contract or grants code. No generic user approval; need ONE actual delta review at published SHA/Docs.
